entries.speaker: Bandwagoning Student
entries.en: You're still rooting for the Phantom[n]Thieves?

entries.speaker: Thieves-Loving Student
entries.en: That doesn't mean that criminals should[n]be left to do whatever they want...

entries.speaker: Bandwagoning Student
entries.en: Still, couldn't they have at least left the[n]principal to the police?

entries.speaker: Bandwagoning Student
entries.en: And I mean, did you see that press[n]conference? No way allies of justice[n]would do that.

entries.speaker: Thieves-Loving Student
entries.en: I wonder if Akechi-kun has been right[n]all along...

entries.speaker: Bandwagoning Student
entries.en: He's so admirable, sticking to his guns[n]even though so many people were[n]against him.

entries.speaker: Ms. Usami
entries.en: That's enough. If you don't quiet down,[n]I'll have to ask you to leave.
